::: {.lede}

I am a Senior Economist in the World Bank's DEC Enterprise Analysis Unit, where
I have worked since 2010. My work focuses on data collection on private enterprise, especially informal businesses. 
My research interests include informality, labor supply, institutional economics, corruption, and political economy.
